messages:
ryan_sales: Hey team — customer asked for a really simple dataflow diagram + list of subprocessors they can include in their vendor risk pack. They want something non-technical for legal + an annotated diagram for engineering. Can we turn this around today?

marta_security: Who's the customer and which region are they hosting in? EU-only?

ryan_sales: BigFinApp, EU (Frankfurt) with potential DR in UK. They explicitly asked about whether any logs or model telemetry leave the EU.

alek_eng: Short answer: hosted Redwood API can be configured to keep inference data in the EU region only. We have dedicated subprocessor list for infra (GCP eu-west/eur3 style) + logging providers. Need to confirm retention & telemetry specifics.

sara_legal: Also need confirmation on KMS location for customer-managed keys, and whether we share any derivatives (embeddings, logs) with third parties.

marta_security: I'll draft the controls bullet list. For the diagram we should show: 1) Customer app -> 2) TLS -> 3) Inference nodes (EU region) -> 4) KMS in EU (optional customer BYOK) -> 5) Persistent storage (EU) -> 6) Monitoring pipeline (pseudonymized, EU). If DR triggers, traffic routed to UK region only.

alek_eng: Quick ASCII sketch I can attach to the pack (engineering view):

```
[Customer App]
    |
    | HTTPS (mTLS optional)
    v
[API Gateway - EU]
    |
    | routed by policy -> can pin customer to EU pool
    v
[Inference Pool - EU GPUs] --- KV cache (in-memory, ephemeral)
    |
    | optional: write artifacts -> [Persisted Storage - EU (S3 compatible)]
    |
    v
[KMS - EU] (customer-managed ok)
Monitoring -> [Observability - EU (logs pseudonymized)]

DR: failover -> [UK read-only standby]
```

marta_security: Add bullets: no model weights leave region, syslogs are pseudonymized before export, access logged with RBAC + audit trail. We support BYOK so keys can stay in customer KMS.

ryan_sales: Perfect. Can we also produce a one-page non-technical diagram for procurement? They asked for a PNG showing "data stays in EU" and a one-line subprocessor list.

alek_eng: I'll export a simplified PNG from the ASCII and include a short legend: "We operate inference in customer-selected region; backups/metrics only if enabled; BYOK supported; subprocessors: cloud provider (region-specific compute/storage), monitoring vendor (EU), KMS provider (customer option)."

docs-bot: docs.redwood.ai/environments/data-residency - public guide on region controls and BYOK. :link:

sara_legal: For the vendor risk pack we need: 1) signed subprocessor list with address, 2) dataflow PNG, 3) KMS attestation option text, 4) retention & deletion policy (EU), 5) SOC/ISO statements for subprocessors. I'll draft legal text, send through review.

ryan_sales: Great — can you aim to deliver the pack by EOD? Customer is starting the procurement review tomorrow AM. :pray:

marta_security: I can provide the control bullets + single-slide diagram in 2 hours.

alek_eng: I'll attach the PNG and an engineering appendix with network ACLs, request routing policy, and sample config for region pinning.

sara_legal: I'll add the subprocessor checklist and a note about SCCs + standard contractual clauses.

ryan_sales: Awesome — thanks all. I'll loop the customer's procurement lead once we have the PNG + subproc list. :thumbsup:
